title: The Pain-Free Desk Guide
hook: Relieve neck, shoulder and lower-back tension caused by long hours at a desk.
ad: Sit all day? Your body is keeping score. The Pain-Free Desk Guide gives you a physiotherapist-built, 10-minute daily routine to undo the damage. No gym, no equipment, just your chair and 10 minutes.
thanks: Thank you for grabbing the Pain-Free Desk Guide! Give the Day 1 reset routine a try today. Your neck and shoulders will thank you.

title: Lower Back Recovery Blueprint
hook: A progressive, phased plan for chronic and acute lower back pain.
modules: What's really causing your back pain
Red flags: when to see a doctor first
ad: Back pain doesn't need to run your life. The Lower Back Recovery Blueprint walks you through the exact three-phase process our physiotherapists use in clinic. Now yours to follow at home, at your own pace.
thanks: Thank you for choosing the Lower Back Recovery Blueprint. Start with Phase 1 today, and remember: consistency beats intensity.

title: Post-Surgery Knee Recovery Roadmap
hook: A 12-week, phase-by-phase rehab plan following knee surgery.
ad: Knee surgery is only step one. Recovery is where the real work happens. This 12-week roadmap gives you a clear, week-by-week plan so you always know exactly what to do next.
thanks: Thank you for downloading the Post-Surgery Knee Recovery Roadmap. Take it one week at a time. We're cheering you on.

title: Prenatal & Postpartum Movement Guide
hook: Safe movement through pregnancy and gentle recovery after birth.
modules: Returning to exercise: a gentle timeline
ad: Every stage of motherhood deserves the right movement. The Prenatal & Postpartum Movement Guide gives you physiotherapist-approved routines for pregnancy and a safe, supported return to movement afterward.
thanks: Thank you for choosing the Prenatal & Postpartum Movement Guide. We're honoured to support you through this season.

title: Athlete's Return-to-Play Protocol
hook: A structured protocol for safely returning to sport after injury.
ad: Rushing back to sport is how injuries repeat. The Return-to-Play Protocol gives athletes and coaches a clear, test-based pathway back to full performance. Built by physiotherapists who work with athletes every day.
thanks: Thank you for grabbing the Return-to-Play Protocol. Train smart, test before you progress, and let's get you back stronger.

title: Posture Reset in 21 Days
hook: A beginner-friendly, day-by-day plan to correct slouched posture.
modules: Why your posture changed in the first place
ad: Better posture in three weeks, five minutes a day. Posture Reset in 21 Days is the simplest place to start if slouching, screen-neck, or a rounded back has been bothering you.
thanks: Thank you for starting your Posture Reset journey! Day 1 takes five minutes. Let's go!
